slots.meaning: The young protagonist who loses the item and searches for it.
slots.guidance: One small child or child-like animal, named or role-named; capable of solving this alone but glad of help. Read as a possessive in two beats ('{HERO}s friends'), so avoid a name ending in s.

slots.meaning: What kind of creature or child the hero is, read right after their name.
slots.guidance: A bare noun phrase that follows 'the' naturally ('fox cub', 'small bear', 'little girl'); never a title or an adjective alone.

slots.meaning: The trusted adult waiting at home with something warm at the end.
slots.guidance: A safe, steady adult of the hero's own household; present only to welcome the hero home, never a source of worry or scolding.

slots.meaning: The named peer the hero can ask for news, who later helps lift the item down.
slots.guidance: One friendly peer the hero's own age, named; helpful and cheerful, never a rival and never the reason the item was lost.

slots.meaning: What kind of creature or child the friend is, read right after their name.
slots.guidance: A bare noun phrase that follows 'the' naturally, matching HERO_KIND's register. The friend is referred to as 'she' in one beat.

slots.meaning: The small crowd of extra friends who join the friend to make a reaching chain.
slots.guidance: A plural, playful group who can stack or link up safely; read after 'the' ('squirrels', 'penguin cousins'). Numerous and small, so the chain is funny rather than risky.

slots.meaning: The chattering creatures overhead who spot the lost item and point the hero to it.
slots.guidance: A plural group that lives above head height and can chirp or call; they only give directions, they never take the item or scare the hero.

slots.meaning: The one cherished wearable the whole story is about recovering.
slots.guidance: A single small worn item that comes in a pair, so losing one leaves the hero half-warm; harmless, recognizable at a glance, and light enough to snag on a branch.

slots.meaning: The lost item's colour, which is how every clue is recognized.
slots.guidance: A bare colour word used as an adjective and also standing alone ('something {ITEM_COLOR}'); one vivid colour that shows against the setting.

slots.meaning: The open place the hero was playing when the item went missing, and the hub every search loops back to.
slots.guidance: One cheerful outdoor spot with room to run, read after 'the'; safe to return to over and over, with nothing hazardous in it.

slots.meaning: The first thing the hero searches under, near the play place.
slots.guidance: A single tall, obvious feature something could be lost under, read after 'the big'; findable without leaving the play area and safe to poke around.

slots.meaning: The second thing the hero searches, a used play surface where a thread could catch.
slots.guidance: A stretch of ground or track the hero plays on, read after 'the' and after 'not on the'; safe to walk and search along.

slots.meaning: The place all three searches converge on, where the hero finally sees the item.
slots.guidance: One nearby outdoor spot every path can reach on foot, read after 'the' and after 'the frozen'; calm and shallow, never deep or fast water and never a place to fall into.

slots.meaning: The warm thing waiting at home, whose smell is one of the three paths from the meeting place.
slots.guidance: One warm food or drink with a smell that carries outdoors; shareable at the end, plain enough for a very young reader to picture.

slots.meaning: The snowy outer things the hero pulls off at home, plural.
slots.guidance: A plural worn item that comes off at the door and could hide something inside it; must be the plural of OUTER_GEAR_ONE.

slots.meaning: One of the outer things, the hiding place the lost item tumbles out of.
slots.guidance: The singular of OUTER_GEAR, read after 'a' and after a possessive; roomy enough that the lost item could sit in it unnoticed all afternoon.
